title: Voxel Rooms  Localize, Tense In and Out, Map the Journey
thesis: The three rooms (Gallery, Gym, Forest) become 3D voxel spaces you navigate. Zoom IN = tense into the room (present tense, you're THERE). Zoom OUT = tense out (past tense, you see the whole journey). The rooms map the journey west (exploration, going deeper) and back (reflection, returning with knowledge). The stories from the campfire become spatial locations you can visit and revisit. The organism has DEPTH, not just pages.

voxel_architecture.what: Each room is a 3D space rendered with CSS perspective transforms. Enter a room = camera moves forward (zoom in). Leave = camera pulls back (zoom out). The rooms have DEPTH  items closer to you are larger, items deeper are smaller. Parallax. Spatial audio (modality-engine already supports HRTF spatial positioning).

rooms_as_spaces.gallery: A long hall. Paintings on the walls (left and right). Sculptures on pedestals in the center. The live easel at the far end, chipmunk painting. You walk forward through the art. Each generation deeper.
rooms_as_spaces.gym: A wide open floor. Arena in the center (models sparring). Benchmarks on screens along the walls. Weight rack (test counts). Treadmills (training runs). You walk around the perimeter.
rooms_as_spaces.forest: A trail through trees. Each tree is a paper. The canopy filters light (fog of war). Mushrooms on the ground (spore prints). Clearings (nightbox campfire). You walk the trail.

tense_in_out.in: Present tense. You're IN the room. The details are visible. The paintings have brushstrokes. The arena shows live scores. The trees have leaves you can read. Close. Immersive. NOW.
tense_in_out.out: Past tense. You see the room from outside. The gallery is a thumbnail. The gym is a stat. The forest is a map. Distance. Overview. THEN.
tense_in_out.between: The TRANSITION is the tense shift. Zoom in = shift from past to present. Zoom out = shift from present to past. The journey IS the tense change. Going west = going in. Coming back = coming out.

the_journey_west.what: The stories map spatially. Story s001 (first campfire) is at the entrance. Story s030 (three rooms) is deep inside. Each story is a location. Walking west = going deeper into the organism. Walking back = retracing with new knowledge.

spatial_story_map.entrance: s001  the first spark. The campfire at the mouth of the cave.
spatial_story_map.hall_1: s006  first cave painting. The gallery begins.
spatial_story_map.clearing_1: s017  kidney net. The first sorting.
spatial_story_map.deep_forest: s021  the stale hook. Learning what NOT to build.
spatial_story_map.summit: s024  the hundred-year object. Tsukumogami. When does code wake up?
spatial_story_map.return_path: s026  the room. Every data center is a room with someone's computer in it.
spatial_story_map.home: s029  the napkin. Human IS the loop. You're back. You know more.
spatial_story_map.gallery_end: s030  three rooms. The organism has rooms now. You're standing in one.

implementation.css_3d: perspective: 1200px on the wrapper. translateZ for depth. Each gallery piece gets a z-index based on generation number. Older = deeper. Newer = closer.
implementation.transitions: transform: translateZ(0) ? translateZ(-800px) for zoom out. Reverse for zoom in. Duration: 0.6s ease-in-out. The tense shift IS the transition.
implementation.spatial_audio: modality-engine.js already has HRTF PannerNode. Position sounds in 3D space relative to the room. Gallery: ambient hum. Gym: rhythmic beats. Forest: wind, birds.
implementation.voxel_grid: petalTongue render_color_grid_webgl() can render 3D grids. Each cell = one story/feed/painting. The reveal_fraction = how deep into the room you've gone. Fog lifts as you explore.
implementation.story_markers: Each campfire story becomes a glowing marker in the voxel space. Walk to it = read it. The stories are PLACED in the rooms, not listed.

story.title: the rooms have depth
story.body: the organism built three rooms and hung art on flat walls. then someone said: make them deep. so the gallery became a hall  paintings receding into the distance, each generation deeper than the last. the gym became a floor  the arena in the center, visible from every angle. the forest became a trail  trees thinning and thickening, clearings where stories were told. you walk in: present tense. you're here. you walk out: past tense. you were there. the transition IS the tense change. the journey west is the zoom in. the return is the zoom out. and each story the chipmunk told at the campfire is now a place you can visit. walk to the marker. read the story. walk deeper. the rooms have depth. the organism breathes in three dimensions.
